contexts.text: The Spirit is then rotated on high...

His wheels like a whirlwind () = the doctrine of (natural truths). ( = the powers of perverting and destroying truths. AC 8215:3.) ( = the ultimates of truth such as are in the sense of the letter, and the confirmations of falsity thereby. AE 355:32.)
In their (punishment of) whirling they tried to draw others... into their whirl, and thus into destruction.
At the noise of his wheels () = the sensuous things and their fallacies which advance (the false doctrine).
The voice of the sound of the wheel () = the defence of falsity by means of fallacies. = reasonings from falsities and evils. AE 355:23.
The wheels of a chariot = the falsities of doctrine. Illustrated.

He took off the wheel of their chariots () = that the power of injecting falsities was taken away... A wheel = the power of advancing. Explained... As this power belongs to the intellectual part of man, a wheel (of a chariot) = the Intellectual as to the things which belong to doctrine. AC 8216. ( = the faculty of reasoning. AE 654:45.)

Thus a chariot wheel = the power which belongs to the Intellectual; for, as a chariot has its motion and advance by means of wheels, so the truths which belong to doctrinal things have their advance by means of the Intellectual. Illustrated.

The wheels (in  and ) = the Divine intelligence, that is, foresight; and therefore it is said that the wheels went together with the living creatures, and that their rings were full of eyes; and also that the spirit of the living creature was in them, that is, the truth of wisdom. AC 8764:4. See AE 283:13.

His wheels as burning fire ()... His wheels = the things which are of wisdom and intelligence, thus truths Divine; and burning fire = which are of love and charity. ( = the doctrine of celestial love. AE 504:3.)
The wheels () = intellectual powers, by means of which there is progression. Compare AC 10236:5.
Wheels = the truths of doctrinal things, from the fact that chariots = the doctrines of truth. References. AE 283:13.

The wheels of the cherubs () = the like as do the arms and feet with man, namely, the power of acting and advancing which belongs to truth from good. Hence it is that their aspect was like that of a beryl stone; for a beryl = truth from spiritual good, which has power.

Wheels, as those of a chariot = the faculty of growing wise when all things enter from Heaven; for thus all things progress according to order; for the wheels of a chariot = the faculty of making progress, thus of learning.
Like a wheel driven round by the hand.
Like two wheels with opposite motion acting against each other... TCR 62.
As a mill [is in motion] from its wheel.
I saw a kind of soft volution... into which I was raised... From this volution, wheels are ascribed to the cherubs. Described.
In the same kitchen was seen a miserable wheel driven by water... This wheel = the spiritual things of (the Quakers).
Evil Spirits have often wanted to throw me under carriage wheels.
(Influx is) like a wheel...
He changed his mind, like a revolvable wheel, into the opposite.
A wheel like a disk...
